verdict.rationale: Mistral is an AI platform and API provider, not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP item ([mistral-docs-22]) is a generic llms.txt line describing MCP as an open standard for connecting models to data sources and tools. It does not document a first-party MCP server or endpoint that external agents can connect to, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.
